summary: Registered a new question and focused experiment on the pending-snapshot completion contract: a five-tick user snapshot request stays pending, times out after the logical clock passes its deadline, the object then accepts a new request that completes with the applied value, and a zero timeout is refused. The first local run exposed a flaw in the probe (it read a stale request from the channel and mismatched keys), so the harness now selects the request matching the pending state and reports stale entries; the corrected run behaved as predicted. Formal receipt pending, no interpretation or knowledge recorded yet.
